name: Violet Tragan
summary: A violet mushroom from Valorwind Lake is Sprinkle’s secret ingredient in Gadgetzan. Cooked into a dish, it makes the food taste wonderful; raw, it is poisonous.

sections.title: A Taste from the Lake
sections.body: Sprinkle in Gadgetzan sends you to the Hinterlands for a violet mushroom found only beneath Valorwind Lake. She says it transformed her sister’s terrible cooking into something she could stomach. Add it to a dish and, if properly cooked, it makes the food taste great. Raw, it poisons whoever eats it.

faq.answer: Violet Tragan is a mushroom from beneath Valorwind Lake in the Hinterlands. Properly cooked, it makes food taste great.

faq.q: Where can I find Violet Tragan?
faq.answer: Violet Tragan grows underwater in Valorwind Lake in the Hinterlands.
Sprinkle in Gadgetzan uses Violet Tragan as her secret ingredient because, when properly cooked, it makes food taste great.

faq.q: Is Violet Tragan safe to eat raw?
faq.answer: No. Raw Violet Tragan is poisonous.

angles.text: As a cook, you can see why Sprinkle prizes Violet Tragan: properly cooked, it makes food taste great.
